# Acme Analytics vs Globex Insights: A Practical Comparison

Choosing a product analytics tool for your B2B SaaS team? Here's an honest, side-by-side look at Acme Analytics and Globex Insights.

## At a glance

| | Acme Analytics | Globex Insights |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Self-serve onboarding | Yes — live in minutes | Yes |
| Warehouse-native | Yes (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) | Limited |
| Free tier | Up to 1M events/mo | Up to 500k events/mo |
| Starting price | $0, then usage-based | $99/mo |

## Where Acme Analytics stands out

- **Warehouse-native by design.** Acme queries your existing data warehouse directly, so numbers match your source of truth without a second ETL pipeline.
- **Transparent, usage-based pricing.** Start free and pay for what you use — no seat minimums.
- **Self-serve onboarding.** Most teams ship their first dashboard the same day.

## Where Globex Insights is a fit

- Teams that want a large template gallery out of the box.
- Organizations already standardized on the Globex ecosystem.

## Bottom line

If warehouse-native analytics and transparent pricing matter to your team, Acme Analytics is the stronger fit. If you want a templated experience inside the Globex ecosystem, Globex Insights is worth a look.
